mustFix.problem: Every image is the same blank gradient placeholder; captions and alt text describe photos that are not there; the page looks unfinished.
mustFix.fix: Curate real approved pest media (crawlspace entry under raised house, mud tube on block pier, probe on sill plate, attic framing, downspout at foundation, hands on label sheet), one distinct frame per slot, then rebuild.

elevate.move: Once real frames exist, make photography part of the signature: every station image gets the same field-notebook frame (figure number, graphite hairline, the station's finding pill pinned to a corner), cropped as one walk-around sequence outside → under → inside → up top → perimeter → report.

Make the hero the first page of the report: diagonal-cut crawlspace photo left, h1 on inspection paper right, the six-station strip styled as the report header row with empty outline pills that becomes the sticky rail on scroll.
